messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Match the reference person's facial features and adjust the body's skin tone accordingly. Do not copy the hairstyle, hair color, or expression from the reference photo. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Match the reference person's facial features and adjust the body's skin tone accordingly. Do not copy the hairstyle, hair color, or expression from the reference photo. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands facing forward, then turns their head and body to the side, briefly touches their chest, and returns to face the camera.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium close-up shot centered on the subject.","clothing":"A white ribbed tank top with a deep scoop neckline.","hair_color":"Dark brown with prominent magenta-pink highlights.","hairstyle":"Short, layered hair with side-swept bangs that is later tied into a small top bun.","identity":"A young adult with a slim build and tanned skin, shown from the chest up.","scene":"A dark, futuristic interior with large glass windows, pink and cyan neon lighting, and a glowing 'TRA' sign in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output person's face appears altered from the source, with a somewhat different facial structure and lighter skin tone, but it does not clearly resemble the reference person's dark-skinned face. The original hairstyle, hair color, clothing, scene, camera framing, and motion sequence remain largely intact.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's identity to match the reference photo, including facial features and body skin tone, while preserving the original hairstyle, hair color, expression, and all other video aspects.
uncertain: Whether the edited facial features sufficiently match the reference identity cannot be confidently confirmed from the frames.
unexpected_changes: The body skin tone appears lighter than the reference person's dark skin tone, contrary to the instruction to match it accordingly.
